Notice
It is to inform all the candidates concerned that as per Chapter V of the
Prospectus 2026-27, the admissions to B.Sc. (Hons.) Ag. 4 year programme for
College of Agriculture, Kishanpura, Yamunanagar (Classes will be held at COA
Kaul) are to be made. The interested candidates who have minimum qualifying marks
50 (Gen/Ews/BCA/BCB) & 47.5 (SC/DSC/PWD) and could not applied for online
counselling earlier, can apply for the same as per following schedule :

Venue: Committee room, College of Agriculture, Hisar
1. The candidates who have allotted seats earlier but not reported due to any
reason now they are interested, they may submit afresh request in the office of
Registrar, Academic Branch, Room No. 205 upto 05.09.2026.
2. The candidates who have already done online counselling for admission to B.Sc
Hons.) Ag. 4 year Hisar, Kaul & Bawal and not allotted seat earlier are not
required to fill the online counselling form again, they may also be consider for
the above counselling.
3. The Students who have already admitted Hisar, Kaul and Bawal if they are
interested to shift college, they may submit request in their college upto
03.09.2026. The others rules and regulations of the prospectus 2026-27 will
remain same.
For latest updates for admission to Undergraduate and Postgraduate
Programmes, the candidates and their parents are advised to keep visiting the
university websites i.e. admissions.hau.ac.in and hau.ac.in.
